Name: The Driskill
Description: 🏨 Your base at 604 Brazos. Explore the historic interiors; dine at The Driskill Grill, have drinks at The Driskill Bar or The Victorian, and stop at 1886 Café & Bakery for breakfast, lunch or cake (closes 3pm). All five hotel entries share this pin.

Name: Texas Capitol
Description: 🏛️ Free Capitol tours and landscaped grounds. Sat: building 9am–8pm; tours 9am–4:15pm, about 40 minutes. Tours start in the South Foyer. 10–15 min walk from The Driskill.

Name: Bullock Texas State History Museum
Description: 🏛️ Texas history, including the La Belle ship. Sat 10am–5pm; adult museum admission $22, films separate. Allow a couple of hours. 20–25 min walk from The Driskill.

Name: Blanton Museum of Art
Address: 200 East Martin Luther King Jr. Boulevard, Austin, TX 78712
Description: 🖼️ Art galleries and Ellsworth Kelly’s Austin. Sat 10am–8pm; adults $15, seniors 65+ $12. Visit Austin in daylight for its colored windows. 25–30 min walk from The Driskill.

Name: Austin Central Library
Address: 710 West César Chávez Street, Austin, TX 78701
Description: 🏛️ Free architecture and roof-garden views; Sat 10am–5pm. Pair with nearby Local Foods, Flower Child or The Baked Bear around Seaholm. 18–22 min walk from The Driskill.

Name: Jo’s Coffee — South Congress starting point
Address: Jo's Coffee, 1300 South Congress Avenue, Austin, TX 78704
Description: 🛍️ Jo’s Coffee is the starting point for South Congress shops and murals. Best late morning or afternoon; shop hours vary. The Continental Club is nearby. 30–35 min walk or 10–15 min ride from The Driskill.

Name: Waterloo Park
Address: Waterloo Park, 1301 Trinity Street, Austin, TX 78701
Description: 🌳 Gardens and paths near the Capitol. Free Diwali celebration Sat Nov 7, 2026, 9am–noon at Meredith Heritage Tree Deck. Park generally 5am–10pm. 12–18 min walk from The Driskill.

Name: Congress Avenue Bridge — Butler Trail access
Address: Ann and Roy Butler Trail at Congress Avenue Bridge, Austin, TX 78701
Description: 🚶 Start at Congress Avenue Bridge for a flexible daylight waterfront stroll. Head west toward the library; turn back whenever you like. This marks trail access, not the lake’s center. 12–15 min walk to the lake from The Driskill.

Name: Dean’s Italian Steakhouse
Description: 🥩 Italian steakhouse with pasta and seafood for the rest of the table. Sat dinner 5–11pm. Reserve ahead; allow time for a full meal. 8–10 min walk from The Driskill.

Name: Cooper’s Old Time Pit Bar-B-Que
Description: 🔥 Convenient downtown barbecue lunch or dinner. Sat 11am–10pm. Meat and sides priced separately; leave time for any queue before a show. 8–10 min walk from The Driskill.

Name: Terry Black’s Barbecue
Description: 🔥 Brisket and beef ribs south of the river. Sat 10:30am–10pm; first come, first served. Aim for early lunch and leave a generous queue buffer. 10–15 min ride · 30–40 min walk from The Driskill.

Name: Roaring Fork
Description: 🍽️ Southwestern steaks, burgers, fish and chicken. Sat dinner 4–10pm; happy hour 4–6pm in the bar/lounge. No Saturday lunch service. 3–5 min walk from The Driskill.

Name: Moonshine Patio Bar & Grill
Description: 🍽️ Southern comfort food with hearty desserts. Sat 10am–10pm; à la carte brunch 10am–2pm. Reservations available. 9–12 min walk from The Driskill.

Name: La Condesa
Description: 🌮 Modern Mexican near Second Street shops. Sat brunch 11am–2pm; dinner 5–10pm. Service breaks between meals; reserve for dinner. 14–18 min walk from The Driskill.

Name: Salty Sow
Description: 🍽️ Manor Road dinner outing: duck-fat fries, chicken thighs and steak frites. Sat 4–10pm; happy hour 4–6pm. Reserve and allow for the ride. 10–15 min ride from The Driskill.

Name: Local Foods
Description: 🥗 Salads, bowls and sandwiches with market sides. Sat 9am–9pm; all-day menu from 10:45am, brunch until 3pm. Pairs with the library and lake. 15–18 min walk from The Driskill.

Name: Flower Child
Description: 🥗 Casual salads and protein plates with vegetable sides. Sat 11am–9pm. Salmon, steak and tofu choices; convenient to Second Street and the library. 16–20 min walk from The Driskill.

Name: Voodoo Doughnut
Description: 🍩 Colorful takeaway doughnuts close to the hotel. Sat 6am–3am Sunday; online orders may stop earlier. Useful after a show. 2–3 min walk from The Driskill.

Name: Amy’s Ice Creams — West Sixth
Description: 🍦 Austin ice-cream favorite; try Mexican Vanilla and mix-ins. West Sixth location. Sat 11:30am–11pm. 20–25 min walk from The Driskill.

Name: The Baked Bear
Address: 211 Walter Seaholm Dr, Suite LR150, Austin, TX 78701
Description: 🍦 Custom cookie/brownie ice-cream sandwiches in Seaholm. Sat noon–11pm. An easy dessert pairing with the library or a lake walk. 20–25 min walk from The Driskill.

Name: The Roosevelt Room
Address: 307 West 5th Street, Unit B, Austin, TX 78701
Description: 🍸 Seated cocktail service; reservations suggested. Sat 3pm–2am; happy hour 3–6pm with select $12 classic cocktails. 8–12 min walk from The Driskill.

Name: Small Victory
Description: 🍸 Intimate classic-cocktail room, especially martinis. Sat 5pm–1am. Look for the entrance by the parking garage; reserve for a fixed time. 2–3 min walk from The Driskill.

Name: Firehouse Lounge
Description: 🍸 Public lounge through the movable bookshelf in the hostel lobby. Sat noon–2am; happy hour until 8pm. Age 21+. 1–2 min walk from The Driskill.

Name: Casino El Camino
Description: 🍺 Long-running rock-and-roll dive with burgers and a jukebox. Sat 11:30am–2am. Go in the afternoon or early evening for a more relaxed Sixth Street stop. 6–8 min walk from The Driskill.

Name: The Cloak Room
Description: 🍺 Small Capitol-area basement dive with a jukebox and established regulars. Sat 8pm–2am. Entrance down an outside stairwell; not a daytime stop. 15–18 min walk from The Driskill.

Name: Donn's Depot
Description: 🍺 Railway-depot bar with dancing and a mixed-age local crowd. Sat 6pm–2am, age 21+; cover varies. No specific Nov 7 act was verified. 8–12 min ride or 30–35 min walk from The Driskill.

Name: Antone’s Nightclub
Description: 🎵 Sat Nov 7, 2026 (CST): Soul Man Sam, 9pm; doors 8pm. Blues and soul; age 21+, mainly standing. Artist lists $15 cover; fees may apply. 5–7 min walk from The Driskill.

Name: Parker Jazz Club
Description: 🎵 Sat Nov 7, 2026 (CST): Kris Kimura Quartet, 7pm or 9:30pm. Seated jazz listening room, age 21+. Book seats together; check current ticket prices. 8–12 min walk from The Driskill.

Name: Elephant Room
Description: 🎵 Sat Nov 7, 2026 (CST): Tommy Howard Quintet, 9pm; bar opens 8pm. $10 cover, age 21+. First-come seats; no reservations. 7–10 min walk from The Driskill.

Name: Flamingo Cantina
Description: 🎵 Sat Nov 7, 2026 (CST): Kabaka Pyramid & Bebble Rockers, with Ras I-Dre and the Royal Frequency and DJ Mista B. Doors 9pm; headliner time unposted. $35 advance/$45 day-of plus any fees; 21+. 6–8 min walk from The Driskill.

Name: The Continental Club
Description: 🎵 Sat Nov 7, 2026 (CST): The Peterson Brothers, 8–9:30pm; doors 7:30pm. Blues, soul and funk on South Congress; age 21+. Check ticket price. 10–15 min ride · 30–35 min walk from The Driskill.

Name: Broken Spoke
Description: 🎵 Sat Nov 7, 2026 (CST): Dale Watson, 9pm. Two-step lesson 8–9pm; arrive by 7:30pm to sign up. Lesson $10 plus show cover. All ages. 15–20 min ride from The Driskill.

Name: The Saxon Pub
Description: 🎵 Sat Nov 7, 2026 (CST): Suburban Beat 3–4:30pm, free. Courtney Patton 6–7:30pm, $25 advance, age 21+; a separate show, with no seat guarantee. 10–15 min ride from The Driskill.

Name: Fallout Theater
Description: 🎭 Out of Bounds, Sat Nov 7, 2026 (CST). 6pm: Booze & The Boys · Comedy Fusion · Touch Baseball with Oscar Montoya. 8pm: Japanese Grandma Funeral · My Boy! · That Felt Good with Oscar Montoya. 10pm: All Four Seasons · Gunk · Outta Gas!. Each block $22.35 incl. fees; check current availability. 8–12 min walk from The Driskill.

Name: ColdTowne Theater
Description: 🎭 Out of Bounds, Sat Nov 7, 2026 (CST). Main Stage 6pm: Doomscroll · Simmer · Live. Laugh. MURDER. Main Stage 8pm: Avery & Sabrina · Cowboy Mama · Lemmingade with Jiavani. Main Stage 10pm: Wolf Town · Bad Magicians · Fuck This Month with Jiavani. Cabaret 6pm: But of Mind · Wickey · Ivories Guy. Cabaret 8pm: Lizzie Kaniecki · Meet Cute · Kyle & Kendon: The Musical. Cabaret 10pm: Pillow Talk · Y’Honor · Ivories Guy. Each block $22.35 incl. fees; check current availability. 10–15 min ride · 30–35 min walk from The Driskill.

Name: Dougherty Arts Center
Description: 🎭 Out of Bounds, Sat Nov 7, 2026 (CST). 6pm: Y’All We Asian · Gooses · The Knuckleball Now!. 8pm: Drunk Theatre · Big Worm · Stupid Fxcking Rich People with Zeke Nicholson. 10pm: Grief Circle · Shoes Off! · All Night All Night All Night with Zeke Nicholson. Each block $22.35 incl. fees; check current availability. 10–15 min ride · 35–45 min walk from The Driskill.

Name: Esther’s Follies
Description: 🎭 Sat Nov 7, 2026 (CST): 7–8:30pm or 9–10:30pm. Scripted sketches, political satire, music and magic. From $30 plus $5.75 fee; reserve a specific performance. 7–10 min walk from The Driskill.

Name: Premier Music Academy — ComedySportz Austin
Address: 1400 E Old Settlers Blvd, Suite 116, Round Rock, TX 78664
Description: 🎭 Sat Nov 7, 2026 (CST): ComedySportz, 7:30–9pm at Premier Music Academy in Round Rock. Clean, all-ages improv games. Listed $15, plus any ticketing fees. 30–45 min ride from The Driskill.
